text: 7月15日，人民银行副行长邹澜在国新办新闻发布会上表示，截至6月末，普惠小微贷款同比增长8.3%，工业中长期贷款同比增长5.9%，不含房地产业的服务业中长期贷款余额同比增长9.2%，这几项都高于全部贷款增速。
text_en: On July 15, PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan said at a State Council Information Office press conference that as of the end of June, inclusive small and micro loans grew 8.3% year-on-year, medium- and long-term industrial loans grew 5.9%, and medium- and long-term loans to the service sector excluding real estate grew 9.2%, all exceeding overall loan growth.
